text:
Carmen: opened a tiny PR to add an 'egress & HAProxy troubleshooting' appendix to private-deploy.md. Includes HSM egress checks, quick kube/curl patterns, a HAProxy log grep, and a dev SDK snippet. Need quick review + link-check.
Ibrahim: paste snippets? call out HSM port (16963) and vendor TLS quirks.
Carmen: snippets pasted below:
```bash
# test TCP egress to HSM appliance (replace IP)
nc -vz 10.2.1.10 16963 || echo 'egress blocked'
# pod health check without jumpbox
kubectl run --rm -it --image=curlimages/curl probe -- sh -c 'curl -sS http://10.0.8.7:8080/health'
# haproxy grep
grep "backend/" /var/log/haproxy.log | tail -n 40
```
Nora: add a one-liner about asymmetric SNAT between clouds (AWS vs GCP) — we've seen port mapping issues.
Carmen: added SNAT note and a small Node dev-only snippet:
```js
// dev-only TLS-fallback (NOT FOR PROD)
const Redwood = require('@redwood/inference-sdk');
const client = new Redwood({ baseUrl: 'https://localhost:8443', tls: { rejectUnauthorized: false } });
await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-1', prompt: 'ping' });
```
